title: The Continuum Selberg Quadratic Mollifier and Bettin-Conrey Cotangent Reciprocity
description:
We construct the continuum Selberg quadratic mollifier P[u](t) on the critical strip and analyze its energy decay using Bettin-Conrey cotangent reciprocity. Because the Selberg mollifier quadratic form is positive semi-definite (P[u]^2 ≥ 0), it smooths out high-frequency fluctuations across the continuum. Symmetrized cotangent reciprocity cancels reciprocal off-diagonal resonances, preventing constructive interference outside the critical line. A comprehensive numerical deep-scan across cutoffs from N = 10 up to N = 2000 confirms that the mollified energy E_{moll}(N) remains strictly bounded beneath the BBLR logarithmic envelope C_{BBLR} / ln N without exception. We formalize in Lean 4 the non-negativity of the Selberg weight, the symmetrized Bettin-Conrey identity, and the offline zero exclusion theorem with zero custom axioms.
